about: Twilight's Eve Callings for the Warrior line (Basic Warrior, Vanguard, Zealot, and Ironclad's and Templar's locked quests). Every spell, talent and tab id is a real 1.12.1 record, checked by tools/twilights-eve/extract_spells.py verify. Design notes: docs/reference/skills-and-talents.md.

formula_conventions.L: the character's level inside its current Tier (1..Tier Cap); it resets to 1 on Advancement
formula_conventions.AP: melee attack power at cast time (Battle Shout and other buffs included)
formula_conventions.W: a normal white-swing damage roll: rand(weapon min..max) + AP / 14 * weapon speed (unarmed: 1..2 dmg at speed 2.0)
formula_conventions.Wn: a normalized roll: rand(weapon min..max) + AP / 14 * normalized speed (2.4 one-hand, 3.3 two-hand, 1.7 dagger), as vanilla Overpower and Mortal Strike
formula_conventions.linear: {base, per_level, per_ap} means round(base + per_level * L + per_ap * AP), rounding half away from zero, never below `min` (default 0)
formula_conventions.rage: rage values are whole rage points; Spell.dbc stores rage costs in tenths (150 = 15 rage)
formula_conventions.realm_vs_client: `client` is what Spell.dbc makes the stock client show and enforce before it sends a cast (cost, range, stance, aura states, on-next-swing); it is checked by the extractor. `realm` is what the Local Realm does; it must keep realm cost >= client cost or the client refuses casts the realm would allow.

tier_bonus.about: Flat additions to base stats (UNIT_FIELD_STAT0..4 base values), cumulative per Tier, applied on top of the race/class base table at the character's current level. +12 Stamina is about +120 health, so a level 1 Tier 1 Warrior (~180 hp) sits near a level 7 Basic Warrior; +12 Strength is +24 attack power.

respec_cost_copper.about: vanilla's escalating wipe cost, reset on Advancement

basic_warrior.armour_note: Gear follows the Calling, never the level: every Warrior weapon from level 1, this armour, and no item refused for level. Plate is for Vanguard and every Calling that branches from it.
basic_warrior.client_shapeshift_form_note: Battle Stance. The stock client refuses a cast whose Spell.dbc Stances mask excludes the current form (0x612480), before sending it. Charge, Rend, Thunder Clap, Hamstring and Overpower all need Battle Stance, so the realm keeps UNIT_FIELD_BYTES_1 byte 2 = 17 for every Warrior Calling. It also makes GetBonusBarOffset() 1, so the main action bar pages to slots 73..84.

advancement_quest.zone_or_sort_note: QuestSort.dbc 81 'Warrior': the stock quest log files it under a Warrior header.
advancement_quest.title: The Warrior's Path
advancement_quest.details: You have learned all a Basic Warrior can learn, $N. Strength alone carried you this far; from here, discipline must carry you further.$B$BTake up the warrior's path and you begin again, untested, among the youngest of our blades. But you will not be the same fighter you were. Your body remembers. Your arm is stronger.$B$BSay the word, and it begins.
advancement_quest.objectives: Speak with the Warrior trainer at the Crossroads to take up the warrior's path.
advancement_quest.offer_reward_text: Then it is done. Forget your old habits, $N: you are a Vanguard now, and a Vanguard starts over. Go and earn your scars again.

objective.note: No item or kill: accept and complete at the same NPC, like vanilla's 'Veteran Uzzek' (1505) speak-to quest.

advancement_quest.flavour_source: Vanilla Horde warrior quests 1505 'Veteran Uzzek' and 1498 'Path of Defense' (Uzzek, Far Watch Post, the Barrens, creature 5810) for tone only; no text is copied.

advancement_quest.title: The Ironclad's Oath
advancement_quest.details: Thirty battles' worth of scars, and still standing at the front. Few Vanguards come this far, $N.$B$BThe Ironclads hold the line when every other blade has broken, and they do not take just anyone. When they are ready to test you, I will send word. Until then, keep your shield arm strong.

objective.note: A single objective the realm never credits (or a kill of a creature entry that is never spawned), so the stock quest log shows it as in progress forever and the trainer shows the 'incomplete' text. Abandoning and retaking it is harmless.

advancement_quest.request_items_text: The Ironclads have not yet sent for you, $N. Patience.
advancement_quest.flavour_source: The vanilla level 30 warrior chain (1718 'The Islander', 1791 'The Windwatcher', 1712 'Cyclonian') for tone only.

zealot.client_shapeshift_form_note: Battle Stance and the rage bar stay. The four borrowed Paladin spells need no stance: the client rewrites their rows (ADR 0003).
zealot.borrowed_note: A skill with `borrowed` is a Paladin spell (SpellFamilyName 10). The client rewrites its row to cost the realm's rage_cost in rage, in any stance, as a Warrior spell (family 4) whose SpellFamilyFlags are only `borrowed.family_bit`, a bit no Warrior spell uses (Warrior spells use bits 0..32). Its `client` half below is the unrewritten Spell.dbc row, so its cost is mana.

skills.name: Seal of Command

realm.effects_note: A 30 s self Seal: a landed white swing has 7 procs a minute (vmangos) of a holy hit of 70% of a weapon roll (20424). Judged: a holy hit under Judgement of Command (20467). Holy ignores armour.

skills.vanilla_reference: R1 is the talent's (Talent 1481) only rank: 65 mana, 30 s, $20424s1 = 70% weapon damage.
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says 70% of normal weapon damage.

skills.name: Seal of the Crusader

realm.effects_note: A 30 s self Seal that replaces any other: 20 + 4 attack power a level, swings 40% faster with each hit cut to match (so the haste alone adds no damage a second). Judged: Judgement of the Crusader Rank 3 (20300) on the target for 10 s, 20% more holy damage taken (vanilla's is a flat amount), its duration refreshed by each landed white swing at the target.

skills.vanilla_reference: R1 21082 L6 +31 AP, R3 20305 L22 +94 AP, R6 20308 +306 AP; every rank 40% faster. R3 sits mid Zealot band.
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says 94 attack power and 40% faster.

skills.name: Judgement
skills.client_note: The cost is 6% of base mana (ManaCostPercentage), which the rewrite zeroes.

realm.effects_note: Consumes the active Seal for that Seal's judgement; with no Seal it fails and costs nothing.

skills.vanilla_reference: The only castable Judgement: 10 s cooldown, 10 yd, off the global cooldown.

skills.name: Hammer of Justice
skills.vanilla_reference: R1 853 3 s, R2 5588 4 s, R3 5589 5 s, R4 10308 6 s: only R4's tooltip says six seconds.
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says stuns the target for 6 sec.

talent_tree.catalog_note: Three tabs from the Callings handoff. Crusade has seven rows, so 30 points in it reach Holy Power and 49 at the cap put 31 or more there with the rest in Blade and Faith. Talent ids and rank spells are real Talent.dbc rows (Paladin Retribution, Protection and Holy, and Vanguard's Warrior rows in Blade) re-seated on the vanilla grid. Blade's first row holds the handoff's first two: Improved Charge and Anger Management alone are 3 ranks, short of the 5 that open a second row. Prerequisites stay inside a tab: Vengeance needs Conviction 5/5; Anger Management, Deep Wounds, Impale and Flurry lose theirs. Talents with no fitting effect kind, or that wait on the Seals, are WIP.

advancement_quest.title: The Zealot's Vow
advancement_quest.details: You fight like one possessed, $N, and some say the Light itself guides your blade. There are warriors who answer that call: Zealots, who strike with holy fury and pay for it in rage, not prayer.$B$BSwear the vow and you begin again, a novice among them. But the plate on your back stays, and your arm is stronger still.$B$BSay the word.
advancement_quest.objectives: Speak with the Warrior trainer at the Crossroads to swear the Zealot's vow.
advancement_quest.offer_reward_text: It is sworn. Seal your blade and judge your foes, Zealot. You start over once more; let your fury carry you.

objective.note: As The Warrior's Path: accept and complete at the trainer.

advancement_quest.title: The Templar's Charge
advancement_quest.details: Fifty battles of holy fury, and the Light has not yet burned you out. The Templars have heard of you, $N.$B$BThey guard what the Zealots only strike for, and they choose their own. When they are ready to test you, I will send word. Until then, keep your Seals bright.

objective.note: As The Ironclad's Oath: offered, never finished.

advancement_quest.request_items_text: The Templars have not yet sent for you, $N. Patience.
